43. 20M-1-37
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.... ....
S.I, Special Branch xxxx Station, 816'
REPORT
Date October 23, 19 37.
Subject Shanghai Vocational Circles Association to save the nation -
registration of technicians and former employees of Japanese concerns.
Made by D.E. Pan Hien-lih Forwarded by C. Gaspar.

The Shanghai Vocational Circles Association to save the
nation, situated at house 4, Line 132, Park Road, have now
commenced registering technicians and employees of Japanese
concerns, who have been thrown out of employment through the
hostilities. Registration is being made at the following
addresses:-
Address Officer in charge
House 4, Lane 132, Park Mr. Pan Hian-yao
Road (office of the (潘仰堯)
Vocational Circles Association)
House 5, Lane 542, Mr. Chao Chung-mei
Avenue Joffre. (邵君美)
80 Route Voyron Mr. Woo Chung-wen
(吴宗文)
Those who apply for registration are required to fill in
forms stating their trade or calling. One form is used for
technicians and another for ex-employees of Japanese concerns.
Copies of those forms are attached to this report with
translations.

（印：RECEIVED 28 OCT 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

Copies to Do. 81 Pan Hien-pih
Mr. Sanky. D. I.
D.C. (Special Branch)
S.I. C. J. S. Lih
R.V.
JSh 29/10 29/10

S.I, 特别部门 xxxx 巡捕房，816'
报告
日期：1937年10月23日。
事由：上海职业界救国会——登记因战事失业的日商企业技术人员及前雇员。
呈报人：D.E. 潘显烈（Pan Hien-lih） 转呈人：C. Gaspar。

位于派克路（Park Road）132弄4号的上海职业界救国会，现已开始登记因敌对行动而失业的日商企业技术人员和雇员。登记地点如下：
地址 负责人
派克路132弄4号 潘仰堯先生
（职业界救国会办公室） （潘仰堯）
霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）542弄5号 邵君美先生
（邵君美）
魏尔蒙路（Route Voyron）80号 吴宗文先生
（吴宗文）
申请登记者需填写表格，注明其行业或职业。技术人员使用一种表格，日商企业前雇员使用另一种表格。这些表格的副本及译文附于本报告之后。

（印：1937年10月28日收讫 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

抄送：同上 81 潘显毕（Pan Hien-pih）
Sanky 先生，督察长（D. I.）
副督察长（特别部门）
S.I. C. J. S. Lih
R.V.
